questions.question: If I had a million rials, I _____ a big house.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم would مع الفعل الأساسي للتعبير عن نتيجة موقف افتراضي.

questions.question: If I were a bird, I _____ fly around the world.
questions.explanation_ar: في الشرط الثاني نستخدم would في جملة النتيجة، ثم الفعل الأساسي.

questions.question: You are a student, _____?
questions.explanation_ar: الجملة مثبتة، لذلك نستخدم سؤالًا قصيرًا منفيًا مع نفس الفعل المساعد.

questions.question: She cannot swim, _____?
questions.explanation_ar: الجملة منفية، لذلك يأتي السؤال القصير مثبتًا can she.

questions.question: Ali said, "I am tired." Choose the correct reported speech.
options: Ali said that he was tired.
Ali said that I am tired.
Ali said that he is tiring.
questions.correct_answer: Ali said that he was tired.
questions.explanation_ar: في الكلام المنقول قد يتحول am إلى was، ويتغير الضمير I إلى he بحسب المتحدث.

questions.question: Sara said, "I like music." Choose the correct reported speech.
options: Sara said that she liked music.
Sara said that I liked music.
Sara said that she like music.
Sara said that she liking music.
questions.correct_answer: Sara said that she liked music.
questions.explanation_ar: عند نقل الكلام في الماضي يتغير الضمير I إلى she، ويتحول like إلى liked.

questions.question: You _____ wear a seat belt in a car. It is important for safety.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم should لتقديم النصيحة أو التعبير عن التصرف المناسب.

questions.question: _____ I borrow your pencil, please?
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم May لطلب الإذن بطريقة مهذبة.

questions.question: You _____ not park here. It is forbidden.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم must not للتعبير عن المنع.

questions.question: When my father was young, he _____ run very fast.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم could للتعبير عن قدرة كانت موجودة في الماضي.

questions.question: I wanted to play outside, _____ it was raining.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم but للربط بين فكرتين متعارضتين.

questions.question: I stayed at home _____ I was sick.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم because لذكر السبب.

questions.question: It was very hot, _____ we went swimming.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم so لذكر النتيجة؛ كان الجو حارًا ولذلك ذهبنا للسباحة.

questions.question: Match each personality adjective with its Arabic meaning.
questions.explanation_ar: هذه صفات تصف شخصية الإنسان وطريقة تعامله مع الآخرين.

questions.question: How does someone feel when they have nothing to do and are not interested?
questions.explanation_ar: Bored تعني يشعر بالملل.

questions.question: We should _____ paper and plastic to reduce waste.
questions.explanation_ar: Recycle تعني يعيد التدوير، وهي طريقة مفيدة لتقليل النفايات.

questions.question: Which action helps save water?
options: Turning off the tap while brushing your teeth
Washing one cup for an hour
questions.correct_answer: Turning off the tap while brushing your teeth
questions.explanation_ar: إغلاق الصنبور أثناء تنظيف الأسنان يساعد على توفير الماء.

questions.question: Match each science word with its Arabic meaning.
questions.explanation_ar: هذه مفردات علمية أساسية تساعد على فهم موضوعات العلوم باللغة الإنجليزية.

questions.question: Mona speaks English _____ than her brother.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم more clearly للمقارنة بين طريقة تحدث شخصين.

questions.question: Of all the runners, Ahmed ran _____.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم the fastest للمقارنة بين ثلاثة أشخاص أو أكثر في السرعة.

questions.passage: Last month, our school held a science fair. Each class prepared a different project. My group made a small model of a solar-powered house. We used cardboard, small solar panels, and wires. Our teacher explained how sunlight can produce electricity. Many students visited our table and asked questions. We felt proud because our project helped others learn about clean energy.
questions.question: What did the students make?
options: A model of a solar-powered house
questions.correct_answer: A model of a solar-powered house
questions.explanation_ar: يذكر النص أن المجموعة صنعت نموذجًا صغيرًا لمنزل يعمل بالطاقة الشمسية.

questions.passage: Last month, our school held a science fair. Each class prepared a different project. My group made a small model of a solar-powered house. We used cardboard, small solar panels, and wires. Our teacher explained how sunlight can produce electricity. Many students visited our table and asked questions. We felt proud because our project helped others learn about clean energy.
questions.question: Which materials did the group use?
questions.explanation_ar: المواد المذكورة في النص هي cardboard وsolar panels وwires.

questions.passage: Last month, our school held a science fair. Each class prepared a different project. My group made a small model of a solar-powered house. We used cardboard, small solar panels, and wires. Our teacher explained how sunlight can produce electricity. Many students visited our table and asked questions. We felt proud because our project helped others learn about clean energy.
questions.question: Why did the group feel proud?
options: Because their project helped others learn about clean energy
Because they won a football match
questions.correct_answer: Because their project helped others learn about clean energy
questions.explanation_ar: شعر أفراد المجموعة بالفخر لأن مشروعهم ساعد الآخرين على التعرف على الطاقة النظيفة.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: If I will see Ahmed, I will tell him.
questions.correct_answer: If I see Ahmed, I will tell him.
questions.explanation_ar: في الشرط الأول نستخدم المضارع البسيط بعد if، ولا نضع will في جملة الشرط.

questions.question: Your friend spends too much time playing video games. Write three sentences giving advice.

criteria: Give at least three relevant pieces of advice.
Use should or should not correctly.
rubric.sample_answer: You should spend less time playing video games. You should do some exercise every day. You should read books and spend time with your family.

questions.explanation_ar: استخدم should للنصيحة، وshould not للنصيحة بتجنب تصرف معين.
